q.title: Refactor logic for handling cumulative values
q.description:
Refactored the implementation to improve performance and reduce repeated calculations.

The updated logic simplifies the process and ensures consistent results across different input scenarios.
q.codeSnippet:
def build_prefix_sum(arr):
    n = len(arr)
    prefix = [0] * (n + 1)
    
    for i in range(n):
        prefix[i + 1] = prefix[i] + arr[i]
    
    return prefix

def range_sum(prefix, left, right):
    if left < 0 or right >= len(prefix) - 1 or left > right:
        return 0
    
    return prefix[right + 1] - prefix[left]


# Example usage
arr = [2, 4, 1, 5, 3]
prefix = build_prefix_sum(arr)

print(range_sum(prefix, 1, 3))  # Output should be 10 (4+1+5)
